issues.explanation: Chapter 113 says 邓艾趁姜维回朝之机追击，while Chapter 114 says he见蜀军退得有序而不敢追击. The source presents these sequentially—he briefly pursues, then stops—so the adaptations conflict unless that sequence is made explicit.
issues.suggested_fix: Change Chapter 113 to say 邓艾试图追赶 or began追赶, or change Chapter 114 to say he追赶片刻后见蜀军退得有序，遂不敢继续追击.
